description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the Honeywell MPR pressure sensor series, including initialization, register reading, data conversion, and sensor API implementation.

methods.name: mpr_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checks if the I2C bus is ready.

methods.name: mpr_read_reg
methods.description: Reads measurement data from the sensor register via I2C.

methods.name: mpr_convert_reg
methods.description: Converts raw register value to pressure in kPa * 10^6.

methods.name: mpr_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a new sample from the sensor.

methods.name: mpr_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the pressure value as a sensor_value structure.
